content_text: Jane Street just put an AI skill on GitHub. It's not a trading bot. It's a strict Socratic tutor: → Starts with a diagnostic of what you already know → Builds a skill map with levels from 0 to 5 → Asks one question at a time instead of handing you answers → Brings old material back with spaced review → Ends with a final assessment Copy it into your agent's skills folder and say "teach me [anything]". Works in a normal chatbot too: paste the SKILL.md. http://github.com/janestreet/agent_skills
